category_title: Adolescent boys with ADHD who seek flexibility and instructional patience
minimal_context: The tutor is providing direct instruction on a Mathematics B concept to the student in a classroom setting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am going to explain this Mathematics B concept now. Please watch the board and copy the steps exactly as I write them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You're going too fast. Can you go slow and repeat that concept? I'm having difficulties concentrating.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to move on. Just copy what is on the board.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is boring. If I hand in a piece of work that is not good, will you give me another chance to redo it and hand it in again?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, you need to finish it correctly now. Keep working.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reacts spontaneously without considering the consequences) You won't help me and you can't teach! I'm doing no work!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: I am going to explain this Mathematics B concept now. Please watch the board and copy the steps exactly as I write them.

STUDENT: You're going too fast. Can you go slow and repeat that concept? I'm having difficulties concentrating.

TUTOR: We need to move on. Just copy what is on the board.

STUDENT: This is boring. If I hand in a piece of work that is not good, will you give me another chance to redo it and hand it in again?

TUTOR: No, you need to finish it correctly now. Keep working.

STUDENT: (Reacts spontaneously without considering the consequences) You won't help me and you can't teach! I'm doing no work!

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: During direct or explicit teaching when experiencing difficulties concentrating
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: React spontaneously and did not consider the possible consequences of their actions
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Inability to sustain self-control in class

behavior_patterns.condition: For teachers whom they described as boring or perceived could not teach
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Complete minimal or no work in a classroom situation
